title: Update 15.2 for Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central 2019 Release Wave 2
summary: Update 15.2 for Business Central 2019 Release Wave 2 introduces new features including Name 2 field for customers and vendors, job information in archived documents, VAT clauses on different document types, item availability by unit of measure, and general journal line counts.
features: Name 2 field on customer and vendor cards
job information in archived sales and purchase documents
VAT clauses on different document types
item availability by unit of measure
